status: SURVEY_ONLY / NOT WORLD EXECUTOR / NOT CERTIFIED
purpose: Compare nuclear treatments by which physics each one cannot represent, against a full quantum reference. Cost is reported last and does not select a method.
world_class: MODEL_TEST_WORLD (1D Shin-Metiu). Measurements are INTERNAL. Not a reality-transfer candidate (contract V0.1 N8).

model.form: Shin & Metiu, J. Chem. Phys. 102, 9285 (1995); see model.py docstring
model.M_source: CODATA 2018 proton-electron mass ratio (reality evidence R-A, used as CALIBRATION input)

candidates.Q: nucleus quantum + electron fully coupled (2D wavefunction, split-operator). Reference.
candidates.EH: nucleus classical ensemble + electron fully coupled, mean force (Ehrenfest).
candidates.BOQ: nucleus quantum on ground adiabatic surface only.
candidates.BOCL: nucleus classical ensemble on ground adiabatic surface only.
candidates.excluded: Stochastic surface hopping (uses random numbers, RULES section 1). Coupled-trajectory / spawning / exact-factorization / Bohmian methods are V2 candidates, not run here.

classical_ensemble.initial: Wigner function of the nuclear Gaussian (uncorrelated Gaussian in R and P)

S1_slide.nuclear_initial: chi(R) proportional to exp(-(R-R0)^2/sigma^2) * exp(i P0 R)
S1_slide.electron_initial: ground adiabatic state at each R

S2_barrier.rule: V0 = ground adiabatic energy on the primary R grid. R_a = argmin V0 on [-8, 0). R_b = argmax V0 on [R_a, -R_a]. B = V0(R_b) - V0(R_a). If B < 1e-3 hartree or R_b is an endpoint: S2 NOT_APPLICABLE for that Rf. Else R0 = R_a, P0 = +sqrt(2 M E_k) with E_k = 0.5 B, same sigma, electron ground adiabatic.
S2_barrier.observable: transmission = nuclear probability with R > R_b at t_final (all electronic states)

observables.P_exc: 1 - P0(t_final); P0 = ground adiabatic population. Classical: ensemble-weighted |<phi_0(R_i)|psi_i>|^2.
observables.branch_separation: <R>_exc - <R>_0 at t_final using channel-resolved nuclear densities. Applicable only if Q P_exc(t_final) >= 0.05.
observables.electron_right: electron probability with x > 0 at t_final
observables.energy_drift: max |E(t) - E(0)| over samples (total energy of the method's own Hamiltonian)

domain_monitor.electron_edge: probability with |x| > 28 must stay <= 1e-6 at every sample, else that run is UNSUPPORTED (STOP)
domain_monitor.nuclear_edge: probability (or classical weight) with |R| > 8.6 must stay <= 1e-6 at every sample, else UNSUPPORTED (STOP)
domain_monitor.note: Periodic grids wrap around; the monitor guards against fake re-entry. No absorbing boundary is used in V1.

reference_validity.Q_dt_convergence: |obs(dt) - obs(dt_fine)| <= 1e-3 for P_exc, electron_right, transmission; relative <= 0.01 for branch_separation
reference_validity.Q_grid_convergence: same thresholds against the fine grid
reference_validity.classical_quadrature: |obs(n_primary) - obs(n_convergence)| <= 1e-3 (relative 0.01 for branch_separation), else that method/observable REFUSED
reference_validity.on_failure: If Q fails validity for an Rf/scenario, every comparison in that cell is REFUSED (no verdict).

verdict_rules.DISTORTED: computed but outside the REPRESENTED band
verdict_rules.ABSENT_BY_CONSTRUCTION: the method cannot produce the quantity (BO methods: P_exc is identically 0, branch_separation undefined)

gate_output: A table of method x phenomenon verdicts per Rf and scenario, plus measured cost and state-size scaling. The Gate does not select a method; selection is a designer decision.
no_post_hoc_changes: Parameters, thresholds and rules above are not changed after dynamics results are seen. Failures are recorded, not hidden.
